turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
You gave my son a zero. I want to know why.
Funny. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Which part of that is funny?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? I'm not sure what that's supposed to mean, and I have a client call shortly. You've made a claim about Owen's essay, so show me what it rests on.
I'm not the one who has to account for anything here. Owen's essay. What do you have?
